vectors.name: a_new_hosts_id
vectors.why: The ID a host makes at start, with no statement yet, and its key's word that it's this host.

vectors.name: a_rotated_coded_id
vectors.why: A host that set its code and rotated its key signs with the key its ID counts now.

vectors.name: a_recovered_id
vectors.why: And after a recovery, with the key the recovery named.

vectors.name: another_hosts_name
vectors.why: A host's statement names its own name, so it can't be served as another host's.

vectors.name: another_id
vectors.why: Nor stand for an ID it doesn't name.

vectors.name: a_key_the_id_doesnt_count
vectors.why: The page's key has to be the one the ID counts now.

vectors.name: signed_by_a_key_given_up
vectors.why: A key the ID no longer counts can't vouch for it, even if a thief still holds it.

vectors.name: a_wrapper_of_someone_elses_key
vectors.why: An event naming a host's key under a stranger's rule needs that key's own statement, which the stranger can't sign.

vectors.name: halfway_through_a_rotation
vectors.why: With two keys counting there's no one key to be the host's.

vectors.name: another_objects_signature
vectors.why: Another signed object by the same key can't pass for this one.

vectors.name: a_rotation_is_followed
vectors.why: A key that counted named the next, so a host that pinned the ID takes it.

vectors.name: a_recovery_is_followed
vectors.why: The backup named the next key.

vectors.name: a_recovery_built_on_an_older_copy_wins
vectors.why: A recovery beats key statements made since the copy it was built on, so an operator who restored an old backup still wins every host back.

vectors.name: the_same_copy_changes_nothing
vectors.why: What a host holds already isn't a change.

vectors.name: an_older_copy_is_refused
vectors.why: Whoever serves the name can't bring a key given up back.

vectors.name: a_thiefs_rival_rotation_is_refused
vectors.why: A thief holding a key that counted rotates a copy of their own, which parts ways with the pin and has no recovery.

vectors.name: another_id_at_the_name_is_refused
vectors.why: An ID of the attacker's own, served at the host's name.

vectors.name: a_bare_pin_takes_its_keys_id
vectors.why: A pin made before the host had an ID takes the ID its key signs for.

vectors.name: a_bare_pin_follows_a_history_its_key_began
vectors.why: And follows a rotation its key began, so a host that rotated before this peer looked again isn't lost.

vectors.name: a_bare_pin_refuses_a_wrapper
vectors.why: An event naming the pinned key, moved on by a recovery under the attacker's rule, wasn't begun by that key.

vectors.name: a_bare_pin_refuses_another_key
vectors.why: An ID with nothing after its event, around another key.

vectors.name: a_bare_pin_refuses_another_keys_history
vectors.why: An attacker's own ID whose first statement its own key signed, so only the key it names tells it from one the pinned key began.
